Latest Projects

Sleep Apnea Detection Using ECG

ECG captured with electrodes and an AD8232 module, amplified with IC 741 / LM324 op-amps, and cleaned with high-pass, low-pass and band-pass filters. Arduino UNO sends data to MATLAB to show normal and apnea waveforms, and an LED alerts on apnea.

Driver Drowsiness Detection

Front-end IoT dashboard that displays driver drowsiness data from sensors to monitor alertness.

Pill Reminder Box (IoT)

Smart medication reminder using an ESP32, LCD and sensors that alerts users at medication times.

Booking & Portfolio Websites

A social media booking website and a portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Node.js.
